# TS2Vec external dependency

This folder contains the minimal official TS2Vec source subset required by
`notebooks/train_ts2vec_v2.ipynb`.

Original repository:
https://github.com/zhihanyue/ts2vec

Paper:
TS2Vec: Towards Universal Representation of Time Series (AAAI 2022)

The original source is distributed under the MIT License; the original LICENSE
is retained in this directory. No claim of authorship is made over the TS2Vec
implementation.
